# edition: Breitkopf & Härtel, Beethovens Werke Serie 1 No. 8 (IMSLP #61814), pdf <work>/dl/scores/b8.pdf
# time signature 2/4 throughout; beat unit = quarter (beats 1-2; x:3 = end of bar x). Positions to the nearest 16th (.25), read from the engraving.
# Bars counted from bar 1 (full first bar, no upbeat bar). Scoring: 2 fl, 2 ob, 2 cl in B-flat, 2 bsn, 2 hn in B-flat basso, strings; no trumpets or timpani in this movement.
# Voices: a staff with one line and a whole-bar rest for the other voice is given to player 1 only; two-note chords / two stems to both.
# Flute: single-line passages show a second-voice rest, read as fl1 alone; bars 25 and 53-55 (a2) both.
# Doubts: beat positions of dynamics placed under 32nd/16th figures are approximate (+-0.25 beat); the ff in bar 56 (just after the range) is not transcribed.
# Dynamic in bar 1 for winds is printed "pp sempre staccato" under each wind staff.
